_metadata.title: TipKur Common Surnames Lineage Dataset
_metadata.description: Historical clan connections, kur clusters, and lineage records for Khasi surnames.

credits.note: The foundational genealogical dataset and historical lineage connections are sourced from the dedicated research and literature of two revered authors: Rev. I. Kharkongngor and Babu Spiton Kharakor. We express our profound gratitude and credit to both authors for their tireless hard work and lifelong dedication in documenting, preserving, and honoring the ancestral heritage of Ka Jait Bynriew U Hynñiew Trep.

clusters.title: Ïaw Shi Bdi (Diengdoh / Laloo / Lamin / Pyrbot / Syngngai)
clusters.summary_khasi: Kine ki 40+ tylli ki kur (lait noh ki Syngngai) ki mih na ki 20 ngut ki khun kynthei ka Ïaw Shi Bdi bad u Riang Bareh. Ki Syngngai pat ki la ïateh kur bad ki Diengdoh ha Sohra.
clusters.summary_english: Over 40 clans across War Jaiñtia, Jowai, Khasi Hills, and Bhoi descend from the 20 daughters of Ka Ïaw Shi Bdi and U Riang Bareh. Syngngai bound themselves via ïateh kur with Diengdoh in Sohra.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004) & Medro Singh Diengdoh, Entries #28, #44, #50, #67 (Pages 89, 91–92, 96)

clusters.title: Ïaw Shi Bdi (Diengdoh / Laloo / Lamin / Pyrbot / Syngngai)
clusters.summary_khasi: Kine ki 40+ tylli ki kur (lait noh ki Syngngai) ki mih na ki 20 ngut ki khun kynthei ka Ïaw Shi Bdi bad u Riang Bareh. Ki Syngngai pat ki la ïateh kur bad ki Diengdoh ha Sohra.
clusters.summary_english: Over 40 clans across War Jaiñtia, Jowai, Khasi Hills, and Bhoi descend from the 20 daughters of Ka Ïaw Shi Bdi and U Riang Bareh. Syngngai bound themselves via ïateh kur with Diengdoh in Sohra.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004) & Medro Singh Diengdoh, Entries #28, #44, #50, #67 (Pages 89, 91–92, 96)

clusters.title: Nongkynrih / Shadap / Nongbri / Passah / Lyngdoh Kynshi
clusters.summary_khasi: Ki kur Nongkynrih, Shadap, Passah, Nongbri, Lyngdoh Kynshi, Lyngdoh Nongbri, Marboh, bad Namsheh ki ïalong shikur (kawei ka kpoh) bad kim bit ban ïashongkha (Sang). Ha Riangmang (p. 93) ïa ki Nongkynrih la khot 'Nongphod'. Ki Pombah bad Wahbah ruh ki ïateh kur bad ki Shadap.
clusters.summary_english: Nongkynrih, Shadap, Passah, Nongbri, Lyngdoh Kynshi, Lyngdoh Nongbri, Marboh, and Namsheh share the same clan lineage (ïalong shikur) and cannot intermarry (Sang). Pombah and Wahbah are also prohibited from marrying Shadap.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004), Entries #57, #76, #92 (Pages 93, 95, 97, 98)

clusters.title: Ïaw Shi Bdi (Diengdoh / Laloo / Lamin / Pyrbot / Syngngai)
clusters.summary_khasi: Kine ki 40+ tylli ki kur (lait noh ki Syngngai) ki mih na ki 20 ngut ki khun kynthei ka Ïaw Shi Bdi bad u Riang Bareh. Ki Syngngai pat ki la ïateh kur bad ki Diengdoh ha Sohra.
clusters.summary_english: Over 40 clans across War Jaiñtia, Jowai, Khasi Hills, and Bhoi descend from the 20 daughters of Ka Ïaw Shi Bdi and U Riang Bareh. Syngngai bound themselves via ïateh kur with Diengdoh in Sohra.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004) & Medro Singh Diengdoh, Entries #28, #44, #50, #67 (Pages 89, 91–92, 96)

clusters.title: Majaw & Sangkli (16 Jait)
clusters.summary_khasi: Khathynriew (16) jait ki kpoh kiba la mih na ka kur Majaw. Baroh ki ïalong shikur bad sang ban ïashongkha.
clusters.summary_english: Sixteen clans emerged from the Majaw clan. All 16 share the same ancestral lineage and cannot intermarry.
clusters.citation: Ka Seng Kur Majaw & Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004), Entries #65 (Page 96)

clusters.title: So Kpoh Khatar Wyrnai (Bon / Teiñ / Wet / Doh)
clusters.summary_khasi: So Kpoh Khatar Wyrnai ha Jaiñtia: Bon, Teiñ, Wet, bad Doh lem bad ki tnad kpoh jong ki.
clusters.summary_english: The historic 'So Kpoh Khatar Wyrnai' (Four Wombs, Twelve Branches) of Jaiñtia Hills.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004) & Spiton Kharakor, Entries #3 (Page 86)

clusters.title: Khongsngi / Lyngdoh Mawphlang / Rapthap / Thawmuit
clusters.summary_khasi: Baroh kine ki dei ki khun ka Khmah Lyngdoh Mawphlang (bad ha Riangmang la khot 'Kyllang'). Ki Lyngdoh Sangriang ruh ki ïadei kur bad ki.
clusters.summary_english: All descend from Ka Khmah Lyngdoh Mawphlang, with Lyngdoh Sangriang also bound by clan kinship.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004), Entries #29 (Page 89)

clusters.title: Lyngkhoi / Lyngdoh Nonglait / Sawkmie / Thangmyrsiang
clusters.summary_khasi: Mih na ki saw ngut ki khun kynthei ka kmie tymmen Lyngkhoi ha Nongsynrieh (Mawkyrwat): Lyngdoh Nonglait, Sawkmie, Lyngkhoi Ñiuh, bad Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang. Ki ïakam kur ruh bad ki Nongrum.
clusters.summary_english: Descends from four daughters of the first Lyngkhoi ancestress in Nongsynrieh: Lyngdoh Nonglait, Sawkmie, Lyngkhoi Ñiuh, and Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang. Also bound with Nongrum.
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004), Entries #55 (Pages 94–95)

clusters.title: Lyngdoh Nongbsap / Nongbsap Pyrtuh / Nongrang / Sohphoh
clusters.summary_khasi: Lyngdoh Nongbsap, Nongbsap Pyrtuh, Nongrang, bad Sohphoh ki dei kawei ka kpoh. Hynrei ki Nongbsap Pyrtuh bad ki Mylliem Pyrtuh KIM DEI KI JUH (Page 96).
clusters.summary_english: Lyngdoh Nongbsap, Nongbsap Pyrtuh, Nongrang, and Sohphoh are one womb. Explicitly distinct from Mylliem Pyrtuh (Page 96).
clusters.citation: Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004), Entries #62, #74 (Pages 95–97)

clusters.title: Mukhim / Shabong / Shallam / Khonglam
clusters.summary_khasi: Lai ngut shipara na Umtangper: kiba leit sha Synteng la khot Shallam, sha War la khot Mukhim, sha Khyrim la khot Shabong. Kawei ka kpoh. Ki Khonglam na Nongblai ruh ki kam kur bad ki Shabong.
clusters.summary_english: Three sisters from Umtangper settled in Synteng (Shallam), War (Mukhim), and Khyrim (Shabong)—one single womb. Khonglam also claims kinship with Shabong.

clusters.summary_english: Nongkynrih, Shadap, Passah, Nongbri, Lyngdoh Kynshi, Lyngdoh Nongbri, Marboh, and Namsheh share the same clan lineage (ïalong shikur) and cannot intermarry (Sang). Pombah and Wahbah are also prohibited from marrying Shadap.
